name: Runner Extras - Virtual Field Table
brief: Proves the virtual Field table (2000000041) enumerates a table's real field metadata.
description: Iterates the virtual Field system table (2000000041) filtered by TableNo and asserts that the real fields of a Workflow-domain table (1523) and a Base App table (18 Customer) are returned with correct No./Name/Type, and that the BLOB and Removed filters behave as BC does. Reproduces the RecoverySolutions EnableWorkflow 'There is no Field within the filter' gap.
